text:
Raj: Heads-up — kicking v2 rollout to eu-west for text-generation route in ~15m. Deploybot scheduled. Please monitor gateway and client telemetry closely.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: v2-api rollout (slice: eu-west). Window: 10:30-11:00 PT. Operators: @Raj @Micah. Rollout id: r-82345.

Micah: Noted. I'll watch p50/p95/p99 and 502/503 spikes.

Sam: quick PSA — last time streaming flip caused client-side chunking to mis-handle trailing CRLFs. Watch streaming error counts.

Raj: good call. We'll include streaming probe in preflight. If we see sustained 502/5xx for any customer above threshold we'll pin them back to v1 and pause rollout. Pin list command below if needed:

```
# deploybot pin tenants
deploy-bot pin-tenants --tenants=tenant-452,tenant-873 --route=/v2/generate --reason="streaming-error spike"
```

Tanya: for release notes, should we call out header normalization change and streaming framing behavior? Some mobile SDKs rely on existing framing.

Raj: yes — add a bullet under Known Compatibility Notes: "v2 changes streaming framing and normalizes API headers (case and whitespace). Mobile SDKs may need patching." Keep it short.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks running:
```
checks: [connectivity, schema, streaming-probe]
streaming-probe: 200 OK (3/3)
schema: ok
connectivity: ok
```

Jordi: What's the exact rollback criteria we agreed on? Need thresholds for on-call and release page.

Micah: propose: error-rate (5xx) > 1% sustained over 5m OR p99 latency increase > 2x baseline for 10m. Also any customer-reported streaming corruption = immediate pause + pin.

Raj: agreed. Add automated alert to runbook: if threshold hit, deploybot should run pin-tenants for affected tenant ids and pause rollout globally.

deploy-bot: Can confirm automation hook created: on-alert -> pause-rollout(r-82345) -> notify channel -> attach recent logs.

Micah: alert triggered at 10:42 PT — small 502 spike in gateway-prod-eu for tenant-873. Investigating now.

Sam: capturing a failing request payload — looks like clients sending a trailing null byte on streamed chunk. Could break v2 framing.

Raj: go ahead and pin tenant-873 now. Sam, add the sample to the ticket.

deploy-bot: Executing pin command...
```
action: pin-tenants
tenants: ["tenant-873"]
status: success
note: "pinned because streaming error spike"
```

Micah: verifying metrics — post-pin 502s for tenant-873 dropped to baseline in ~90s. :thumbsup:

Jordi: I'll update release notes and the rollout page: add the compatibility bullet and note the pinned tenant(s) and the rollback criteria.

Tanya: ops checklist updated? Need to mention SDK teams to patch streaming framing.

Raj: Yes. I'll ping SDK leads. For now we pause the rest of eu-west rollout for 20m and reconvene after telemetry stabilizes. Thanks everyone.

Micah: ACK, watching.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-82345 paused by automation at 10:44 PT due to manual pin. Logs and traces attached to ticket #INT-82345.

Raj: Closing thread — follow-up in ticket INT-82345 and release notes PR. If anything else pops up ping here.
